description.narrative:
Agriculture in Uganda is mainly rain fed and based on subsistence farming; challenging the sustainability and food security of farmers and making the sector highly vulnerable to weather variability, climate hazards (particularly droughts) and climate change. Majority of Women and youth in Zombo district still live insecure livelihood sources, they largely depends on agriculture as their main source of livelihoods and employment, they have greater financial and resource constraints, lower levels of access to information and services than men. Because of these gender inequalities, women and youth face unique challenges when it comes to sustainable livelihood and climate change. Despite being face-to-face with the problem, women and youth are often not part of the solution. The UN’s Gender Action Plan notes that sustainable development can only be achieved if women are involved in developing and implementing all aspects of climate change mitigation and adaptation The impacts of COVID-19 and climate change have exacerbated food insecurity and that called for urgent intervention to improve on livelihoods of households. In these circumstances, Oxfam would like to support 150 women smallholder farmers to practice climate-smart agriculture to maximise theirproductivity and increase nutrition and income.
1.2 Project participants (profile of project participants, number of people expected to directly participate in project activities)
The project will target 150 vulnerable households in Zombo district and build their capacities to cope and adapt to the impact of the climate change and improve their food and income security.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project’s implementation.
